# Test fixtures

These are captured from real Amazon and YNAB accounts and then scrubbed. Order numbers, names, addresses, card digits, item titles, sellers, ASINs, image ids, YNAB ids, plan, account, category and payee names, and every Amazon token were replaced. Dates were shifted and money was scaled, consistently within each scenario, so sums, tax, and the relationships between the pages still hold exactly. Amazon pages are trimmed to the subtree the parsers read: `data-component` and `aria-hidden` attributes, `a-offscreen` classes, link paths and image `src`s are kept, and everything else (styles, scripts, the userscript's own UI, empty components, item/shipment action links) is dropped. YNAB rows keep their `ynab-grid-*` classes and `data-row-id`. The rows in `transactions-list.rows.html` and `ynab/register-rows.html` are regenerated from the captured data with a template that was checked byte-for-byte against the live DOM. On the order pages, the whitespace between tags is restored as newlines, as the live page has it (a shipment status like "Delivered September 10" depends on it).

| Scenario | Files | Exercises | Ground truth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shared points across two orders | `amazon/order-shared-points.html`, `amazon/order-shared-points-other.html`, `amazon/order-shared-points.transactions.html` | Several deliveries billed as separate charges, plus one points row that pays for two orders. Amazon's own pages disagree with each other. | **Order A** `114-7767348-8987501`, placed Sep 9, 2026. Subtotal $387.80, tax $31.96, summary "Rewards Points" -$23.24, Grand Total $396.52, so the tax-in total is $419.76. **D1**: 3 lines (2× $39.96, $27.96, $39.96), delivered Sep 10, parser estimate $160.02. **D2**: 1× $239.96, delivered Sep 10, estimate $259.74. A's transactions page shows card charges $236.52 (Sep 10) and $136.76 (Sep 9), and **Amazon Visa points $52.16 (Sep 9) listing both A and B**. The list page dates both card charges Sep 10. **Order B** `114-4442968-2608428`: one item $26.72, tax $2.20, summary points -$28.92, Grand Total **$0.00**. The list still shows a **$23.24 card charge tagged to B** (Sep 10). The summaries can't all be right. A's card charges total $373.28, so the points actually covering A are $46.48, and B's card charge plus the remaining $5.68 of points make up B's $28.92. By arithmetic (Amazon doesn't say), $236.52 pays D2 and $136.76 pays D1, each topped up by about $23.24 of points. YNAB has $236.52 on 2026-09-11, $136.76 on 09-10 and $23.24 on 09-10. |
| Three deliveries, three charges, item coupon | `amazon/order-three-deliveries.html`, `amazon/order-three-deliveries.transactions.html` | One delivery per charge, plus a points payment and a coupon that applies to some items only. | `114-0890458-9035361`, placed Sep 6, 2026. Subtotal $145.77, "Your Coupon Savings" -$3.00, before tax $142.77, tax $11.79, points -$26.40 (the payment block says "$26.40 (2640 Amazon Visa rewards) applied"), Grand Total $128.16. **D1**: 1× $20.97, delivered Sep 10. **D2**: $16.47, $20.64, $20.64, delivered Sep 9. **D3**: $14.97, $16.47, $17.97, $17.64, delivered Sep 9. The transactions page shows $22.71 (Sep 9), $42.93 (Sep 8), $62.52 (Sep 8) and Amazon Visa points $26.40 (Sep 6). The list page dates all three card charges Sep 9. The coupon is on D3 only: D1 = $22.71, D2 = $62.52, D3 = $42.93 card + $26.40 points. Spreading the coupon by price, as the parser does, gives estimates of $22.24 / $61.23 / $71.09 instead. YNAB has $22.71 on 2026-09-10, and $42.93 and $62.52 on 09-09. |
| Gift card plus card | `amazon/order-gift-card.html` | Two payment methods on one delivery. | `114-3317431-5179528`, placed Sep 8, 2026. One item $137.08, tax $0.00, "Gift Card Amount" -$95.12, Grand Total $41.96, delivered Sep 9. The list page shows a card charge of $41.96 (descriptor "Amazon.com") and an "Amazon Gift Card" row of $95.12 with no descriptor, both Sep 09. YNAB has $41.96 on 2026-09-09. |
| Partial refund | `amazon/order-refund.html`, `amazon/order-refund.transactions.html` | Tracing a refund back to its original charge and category. | `114-0271446-2821572`, placed Aug 20, 2026. One item $73.98, tax $6.10, Grand Total $80.08. A "Refund Total $68.64" row comes **after** Grand Total. The status reads "Refunded". The transactions page shows refund +$68.64 (Sep 10) and charge -$80.08 (Aug 20). The refund is smaller than the item, so no set of items adds up to it. YNAB has the refund inflow $68.64 on 2026-09-11, and **two** $80.08 outflows on 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-23, both inside the -3..+7 day window and both "🐷 Fun Money A". It also has an unrelated $80.08 *inflow* on 2026-09-08. |
| Transactions list | `amazon/transactions-list.next-data.json`, `amazon/transactions-list.rows.html` | `pageRows` (startup data) and the DOM fallback. | 20 rows, newest first (Sep 13 → Sep 08, 2026), `hasMore: true`. The list is at `props.pageProps.state.transactionResponseState.visibleTransactionResponse.transactionList`. Tokens, ids and `lastEvaluatedPageKey` are placeholder strings. The rows include 3 refunds (+$68.64, +$76.38, +$0.58), 3 points rows ("Amazon Chase Co-Branded Credit Card Rewards", no card digits), and one of them, $52.16, lists two orders. There is one "Amazon Gift Card" row with an empty statement descriptor, and every other row is "Rewards Visa ••••0257". The rows HTML renders the same 20 entries (the live page shows the mask and the digits as separate spans). |
| YNAB register | `ynab/register-rows.html` | Payee, amount and date cells, and split rows. | 31 `.ynab-grid-body-row`s from a card account, with dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`. There are two splits: $105.68 on 2026-09-14 (sub-rows $63.96 and $41.72) and $66.21 on 09-13 ($48.15 and $18.06). Sub-rows have class `ynab-grid-body-sub` and no `data-row-id`. Amounts are drawn as `<bdi>$</bdi>12.34`, and negative balances use "−" (U+2212). The `data-row-id`s match the ids in `ynab/api/plan-transactions.json`. |
| YNAB API | `ynab/api/plans.json`, `ynab/api/plan-transactions.json` | `GET /plans` and `GET /plans/{id}/transactions?since_date=2026-08-15`, shaped as YNAB returns them. | There are 2 plans; the second is archived. There are 61 transactions: 57 with payee "Amazon", 1 transfer (payee "Transfer : 💳 Store Rewards Card", with `transfer_account_id` set, which must never count as an order charge) and 3 from other payees. Amounts are milliunits, and `amount_formatted` has no thousands separator (as YNAB sends it). YNAB usually dates a card charge one day after Amazon's list page. |
